scope: Measurement-first web performance. Numeric/runtime outcomes are gates; implementation techniques are diagnostics.

checks.title: Core Web Vitals budget
checks.next_step: Measure representative pages; prefer field data when available and record lab vs field context.

checks.title: JavaScript transfer/execution budget
checks.next_step: Record compressed transfer size and main-thread cost against a project-defined budget.

checks.title: Image dimensions/formats/weight budget
checks.next_step: Check oversized repository assets plus delivered dimensions/formats/compression.

checks.title: Font-loading strategy and payload
checks.next_step: Review font count/subsets/preload/display behavior and render-blocking impact.

checks.title: Third-party script cost
checks.next_step: Inventory third-party scripts and measure transfer/main-thread/network impact.

checks.title: Long tasks / main-thread blocking
checks.next_step: Profile representative interactions and identify long tasks/CPU hotspots.

checks.title: Critical API latency budget
checks.next_step: Record representative percentile latency and environment/load context.

checks.title: Database/query latency budget
checks.next_step: Use query/profiling evidence for data-backed products; NOT_APPLICABLE for static/no-database products.

checks.title: Cold-start/startup latency where applicable
checks.next_step: Measure provider/runtime cold behavior if the deployment model has cold starts.

checks.title: Performance regression against an agreed baseline/budget
checks.next_step: Compare the current release to the prior accepted baseline with the same methodology.

checks.title: Critical API/document payload budget
checks.next_step: Measure compressed/uncompressed payloads and unnecessary over-fetching.

checks.title: Request count/waterfall review on key journeys
checks.next_step: Measure critical page/journey waterfalls and blocking dependencies.

checks.title: Cache correctness/effectiveness diagnostic
checks.next_step: Only prescribe caching after a measured need; verify personalization boundaries, invalidation and cache hit behavior.

checks.title: Database index/query-plan diagnostic
checks.next_step: Use actual query plans/profiling; source pattern checks alone cannot prove an index is missing.

checks.title: N+1 query diagnostic
checks.next_step: Use query traces/profiling; do not infer PASS/FAIL from grep.

checks.title: Client render/hydration/re-render diagnostic
checks.next_step: Profile only for client-rendered apps and record measured render cost.

checks.title: Code-splitting/lazy-loading diagnostic
checks.next_step: Recommend only when bundle/route measurements show benefit.

checks.title: Provider-managed CDN/pooling/load-balancing architecture review
checks.next_step: Architecture note only; usually NOT_APPLICABLE or provider-managed and never a baseline failure by itself.
